hotspots.title: BYD Racco K-Car Launch in Japan — World's First SDV Kei EV
hotspots.summary: BYD launched the Racco all-electric K-Car in Japan, starting at ~$13,100 USD. It is positioned as the 'world's first SDV-based' light EV, directly competing with Toyota, Honda, and Nissan on their home turf. The model offers up to 320 km WLTC range and qualifies for Japanese subsidies that bring the price below 2 million yen. Covered by 3 platforms.
chase_rationale: Cross-platform resonance (3 sources: S, S, A)
BYD entering Japanese market directly vs legacy OEMs
World-first SDV kei EV with aggressive pricing

hotspots.title: BYD Confirms Humanoid Robot Unveiling in August

The move aligns with a broader industry trend of EV makers diversifying into robotics, as also seen with Unitree's price war driving down humanoid costs.

hotspots.title: Baidu Apollo Go Robotaxi Road Tests in London via Lyft Freenow
hotspots.summary: Baidu's Apollo Go autonomous driving unit has started road tests of its RT6 vehicles in London's Brent borough with safety operators. The service will be available on Lyft's Freenow mobility network, with public rides expected in 2027. This marks a major expansion of Chinese autonomous driving tech into Europe.
